lead: Ishant Sharma is a widely followed Indian cricketer, born on 2 September 1988 in Delhi.
As of 2026, he is 37 years old, and his birth date places him under the Virgo sign.
He has represented Kolkata Knight Riders and India national cricket team and has been recognised with the Arjuna Award.
This profile collects the Ishant facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
